counterfactual_text: Two separated paper pieces appear before the small notch opens, and the tear begins afterward.
positive_text: The notch opens into a growing tear as both sides separate, producing two paper pieces that remain apart.
semantic_text: A sheet of paper pulled from both sides tears outward from a small notch and remains separated into two pieces. Required visible entities: one intact sheet of paper; one small edge notch; both lateral sides of the sheet. At the beginning: paper: one intact flat sheet with a single small notch; paper sides: horizontally aligned and spatially connected. Required state changes: notch length: small to growing tear; paper integrity: one sheet to two pieces; piece separation: connected to separated. These event variables are allowed to change: notch and tear length; paper integrity; distance and shape of the resulting pieces. Preserve throughout: static front camera; paper material and color; plain background and lighting; one sheet of paper at the start; one small notch; the same paper material and pulling direction.
